title: KauntaBook
summary: Serverless SME finance platform: real-time transactions, invoicing and reporting with no servers to manage.
problem: Small businesses need transactions, invoicing and reporting that update in real time, without the cost of running servers they don't understand.
approach: Serverless end to end: Firebase Functions for the financial logic and Firestore for real-time data, with query and caching work to keep it responsive as usage grew.
highlights: Backend on Node.js and Firebase Functions in a serverless architecture.
Real-time financial systems for transactions, invoicing and reporting.

outcome.label: Architecture
outcome.value: Serverless, real-time, no infrastructure to manage
